scripts.build: pnpm --filter @template/shared build && pnpm --filter @template/chat build && pnpm --filter @template/console build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @template/chat lint && pnpm --filter @template/console lint && cd services/agentos && uv run ruff check app tests
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @template/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @template/chat typecheck && pnpm --filter @template/console typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @template/chat test && pnpm --filter @template/console test && cd services/agentos && uv run pytest
scripts.check:placeholders: node scripts/check-placeholders.mjs && node scripts/sync-project-config.mjs --check && node scripts/build-mysql-init.mjs --check
